ctx.x: The other musicians in the Nice deal were Jack Smaley on bass, and a young white American drummer named Richie Frost. Jimmie Davis who was known as Jimmie "Lover Man" Davis because he was one of the co-composers of the famous song, "Lover Man" was engaged as an entertainer. Another singer engaged there was Monique Davis who was French

I had been introduced to Jimmy by Beezie in 1940 because they were both from Leonia, New Jersey, and she had known him a long time before we met. Jimmie sang and accompanied himself on the piano. He had been a warrant officer in the army and came to France after his discharge.
